personas.name: F-E Developer
personas.reaction: A pitch detector as a pure function tested on synthesised sines is code I can trust; a microphone permission flow is where browsers differ, so I want every refusal case on screen.

personas.name: B-E DEv
personas.reaction: Singing to move a paddle is a gimmick, but a fun one I would actually try once, and it costs nothing to whoever never opens the cabinet.

personas.name: Paul - Product Manager
personas.reaction: A fifth game at LV 5, and one nobody has played like this before: a reason to keep shipping through the loop.

personas.name: Lead Engineer
personas.reaction: Same pattern as OMNI DUET, good; but a voice-only game in an open space, with one limit for every voice, will split the team.

personas.name: Irisa
personas.reaction: A quick win for the people who play; nothing in it reaches my customers.

objection.text: In an open space a game you must sing to play disturbs the whole team, and with one fixed limit at 220 Hz part of the team will spend the match straining their voice instead of playing.
